June Goodband

Peace and Justice candidate for Governor, Vermont · Challenger

Licensed clinical mental health counselor

June Goodband is a licensed clinical mental health counselor from Springfield, Vermont, and is running for governor as the Green Mountain Peace and Justice Party candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election. She ran for governor on the same party's ticket in 2024. The Vermont Secretary of State's candidate listing includes her, according to WAMC.

Where Goodband stands

Education governance and funding
Proposes taking health insurance costs out of the education budget by implementing Vermont's universal health care law, and appointing a secretary of education approved by the Senate after seeking public input.
Health care
Supports fully implementing Vermont's universal health care law, taking insurance companies out of the system and creating a coordinated health care system. She calls health care a human right.
Affordability and cost of living (housing)
Proposes that the state build, buy and renovate housing and sell co-op apartments and simple houses to low-income people at zero percent interest. Supports incentives for people to share their homes.
Property taxes
Supports high taxes on homes left vacant for large parts of the year. Her platform calls for higher taxes on high incomes instead of on homes.

Background

  • Licensed clinical mental health counselor and psychotherapist in Springfield, VT, for more than 30 years
  • Peace and Justice Party candidate for Vermont governor, 2024 (about 1.2% of the vote)
  • Peace and Justice Party candidate for Vermont governor, 2026
